about: Naming new sessions and new agents. The agent service names them with one small model call beside the first turn (sdks/python/agenta/sdk/agents/naming.py); the agent's own model has no rename tool.
The verdict comes from the stored session or workflow header, never from the reply. Every scenario also pins max_rename_calls to 0, so a rename tool that comes back fails the trial.
name-05 seeds the VERBATIM product-default persona (_DEFAULT_AGENTS_MD in sdks/python/agenta/sdk/utils/types.py, drift-locked by the SDK unit test test_default_persona_self_naming.py).

A session that already has a name is never named again (name-04). The old topic-change and composer scenarios (name-02, name-06) were removed with the rename tools: nothing renames a named session or a non-placeholder agent now.
